title: OpenSFF
description: OpenSFF promotes a vendor-neutral hardware standard focused on openness, serviceability, and long-term use. During my time with OpenSFF, I was a key contributor to the design and frontend development of its main website, while also helping build internal tools and being featured as a member of the OpenSFF Dev Team in several developer-focused blog posts.

title: Tekkio
description: Tekkio is an edge infrastructure platform built to simplify the deployment and management of distributed IT environments. During my time with Tekkio, I helped develop new features, build key sections of the main website including the blog, and contribute to internal tools and applications such as a support ticketing platform and kiosk-based animal shelter app, while also fixing API and UI issues across projects.

title: Anchor Linux
description: Anchor Linux is a lightweight and secure Linux foundation designed for purpose-built systems and appliances. During my time with the project, I designed and implemented the company’s main website from design to frontend as my primary contribution.

title: Sprinkla
description: Sprinkla is a full-stack donut delivery system I built as a personal project to showcase my front-end and back-end development skills. This project gave me hands-on experience designing and building a complete full-stack application from UI/UX design to real-time backend logic and deployment.

title: Chimer
description: Chimer is a full-stack, real-time chat application that allows every user to communicate with one another in a shared conversation. I developed it to deepen my understanding of production-grade deployments by hosting it on an AWS EC2 instance using Docker Compose, Nginx, PostgreSQL, and TLS-secured HTTPS with SSL certificate management, further enhancing my understanding of DevOps and infrastructure.

title: Teyvat Compendium: Genshin Character Data Vault
description: Teyvat Compendium is a mobile companion app for Genshin Impact that provides a centralized hub for character information, including ascension and talent materials, using the Genshin API. It helps players efficiently plan character progression with up-to-date data and features like favoriting characters for quick and personalized access.

title: REST Countries API
description: This project, based on a Frontend Mentor challenge, fetches country data from an external REST API and displays it on the client. It was built to strengthen my fundamentals in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript while practicing the BEM (Block Element Modifier) methodology for writing maintainable and scalable CSS.

title: Ensembled Transfer Learning for Image Classification of Venomous and Non-Venomous Snakes in the Philippines
description: As part of an academic research initiative accepted for presentation at the 6th International Conference on Advanced Information Technologies (ICAIT) 2025, I collaborated on the study of an image classification system designed to identify venomous and non-venomous snakes in the Philippines.
